description.value: Gratify Foods is a health-focused, 100% plant-based café in downtown Penticton founded by holistic nutritionist Connie Oickle, serving entirely gluten-free, dairy-free, and refined-sugar-free food made in-house. The menu spans daily breakfast sandwiches, wraps, soups, stir fries, grab-and-go bowls, and a signature line of cashew-based cheesecakes available for drop-in or pre-order. It stands out as one of the very few fully vegan and gluten-free dining options in the Okanagan, making it a notable destination for cyclists with dietary restrictions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at gratifyhealth.ca is live and matches the OSM phone (250 493 1997) and address (544 Main Street, Penticton BC), but the business calls itself 'Gratify Health' throughout, not 'Gratify Foods' as in OSM. Takeout and grab-'n'-go are explicitly stated on the website; the full menu is 100% plant-based, gluten-free, and refined sugar-free per multiple website passages. Wi-Fi appears in OSM tags (internet_access=wlan) but is not mentioned anywhere on the website, so it is left null per the rules.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Gratify Foods' but the website consistently uses 'Gratify Health' (including the domain gratifyhealth.ca and copyright notice). The OSM name may be outdated or incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café with a confirmed website and address in downtown Penticton; strong appeal to cyclists with dietary restrictions.
